script: Hello! Today we learn to add big numbers. In class, add is ಕೂಡಿಸು. Take some sticks. Ten loose sticks make one bundle, one ದಶಕ. Let us add 111 + 379. Write them in the place-value table: hundreds, tens and ones. First add the ones: 1 + 9 = 10. Ten loose sticks make one new ದಶಕ bundle. Write 0 in the ones place and carry 1 bundle to the tens. Now add the tens with the carried bundle: 1 + 7 + 1 = 9. Then add the hundreds: 1 + 3 = 4. So the ಮೊತ್ತ is 490. Well done! ಮೊತ್ತ means the total. Now ಕೂಡಿಸು the sums on textbook part 1, page 85. Show your teacher when you come back. Your friends are waiting!

glossEn: This catch-up teaches 3-digit addition with carrying. Using bundles of ten sticks and loose sticks in the place-value table, the child adds 111 + 379 to get the total 490, carrying one ten from the ones. Homework: textbook part 1, page 85. Show your teacher.
